ns2:course.label: Public School Art Programs
ns2:course.description: The selection and arrangement of content for different educational levels; study and evaluation of curricula, equipment, and supplies; and program supervision. Prerequisite: ARTE 301 or junior standing in art, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ARTE 301 or junior standing in art, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Class Materials Fee of $20 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
